Bundled so text reading works offline. Apache License 2.0 (see the LICENSE files).
- tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js: tesseract.js 6.0.1 (github.com/naptha/tesseract.js)
- tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js: tesseract.js-core 6.0.0, Tesseract compiled to WebAssembly
- eng.traineddata.gz: English LSTM model from tessdata_best (integer), via @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0
